title: SSC MTS Full Length Mock Test 14 (Hard Level)
description: Hard Level Full Length Mock Test for SSC MTS. 90 Questions | 90 Minutes | Numerical Ability 20, Reasoning Ability 20, General Awareness 25, English Language 25. 3 marks each, negative 1.
instructions: Yeh Hard Level Full Length Mock Test hai.
Total 90 questions: Numerical Ability 20, Reasoning 20, General Awareness 25, English 25.
Har question 3 marks ka hai. Galat jawab par 1 mark kat sakta hai.
SSC MTS latest CBT pattern ke anusar.

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: The average of 11 numbers is 50. If the average of first 6 is 49 and that of last 6 is 52, the sixth number is:
questions.explanation: Total 11 numbers = 550. First 6=294, last 6=312. Sixth is in both: 294+312-550=56.
